metadata.scenario: A returning customer is dissatisfied with the pest control service effectiveness and wants a follow-up. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. My wife just had a stroke and needs some help at home. Of course, David. I'm sorry to hear about your wife. What services are you looking for? We need physical therapy and skilled nursing care, specifically. Her recovery is really important to us. Absolutely, we can definitely assist with both of those services. Let’s discuss your needs in detail. That sounds good. I just want to make sure we get the right level of care for her. I understand completely. For physical therapy, we have Dr. James Rodriguez, who specializes in stroke recovery. Great, what about skilled nursing? Our Director of Nursing, myself, can coordinate skilled nursing services. We focus on medication management and rehabilitation. That’s reassuring. What are the costs associated with these services? For skilled nursing, rates range from $95 to $125 per visit, and physical therapy is between $110 and $140. Okay, that's helpful to know. How often would you recommend these services? Typically, we suggest at least three times a week for physical therapy initially, depending on her progress. That makes sense. And I understand you do care plan development, right? Yes, we do. Our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, can assist with that. I'd like to get her involved as soon as possible. Can you set up a meeting? Absolutely! I can arrange that for you. Would you prefer a call or an in-person meeting? A call would work best for our schedule. Got it. I’ll have Lisa reach out to you. Can I have your best phone number? Sure, it's +13165556203. Thank you, David. I’ll ensure Lisa contacts you this week. I appreciate it. Is there anything else we need to discuss? Just one more thing, are you interested in having a caregiver for daily support alongside the therapy? Yes, I think that would be helpful for her. Perfect, that would be our Personal Care Assistance service, priced at $28 to $35 per hour. That sounds reasonable. Can we include that in the care plan? Absolutely! I’ll make a note for the care plan. Thank you, Margaret. I feel better knowing we have support. You're very welcome, David. We’re here to help. Expect a call from Lisa soon. Thanks again for your assistance! Have a great day, David. Goodbye! Goodbye!
